narrative.Summary: Implement WhatsAppVoiceProvider: the first real VoiceProvider implementation. Constructor takes a WhatsAppConnectionManager instance (DI pattern). Handles inbound and outbound WhatsApp voice/video calls by delegating to the shared WASocket. Single-socket constraint is enforced by construction — no second socket is ever created. This scope also defines the WhatsAppConnectionManager interface that the openclaw WhatsApp plugin implements.
narrative.Traces: FR-6 (WhatsAppVoiceProvider, DI, single-socket), NFR-4 (zero core deps; WhatsApp provider may depend on @whiskeysockets/baileys)
narrative.Acceptance: WhatsAppVoiceProvider constructor compiles with just a WhatsAppConnectionManager. Unit tests using a mock WASocket pass for: inbound call event → triggerIncoming → MockCall lifecycle. simulateAnswer/reject with mock socket. Single-socket invariant test: instantiating two providers with the same manager does not open a second socket.

items.title: src/providers/whatsapp/connection-manager.ts — WhatsAppConnectionManager interface
items.narrative: Defines the interface that the openclaw WhatsApp extension must implement to plug into this SDK. Methods: registerVoiceProvider(provider: VoiceProvider): void; onCallEvent(cb: (event: WhatsAppCallEvent) => void): void; answerCall(callId: string, opts?: { video?: boolean }): Promise<void>; rejectCall(callId: string, reason?: string): Promise<void>; joinGroupCall(groupJid: string, opts?: any): Promise<void>. WhatsAppCallEvent = { callId, from, isGroup, isVideo, timestamp }. This is an interface only — no implementation.

items.title: src/providers/whatsapp/whatsapp-call.ts — WhatsAppCall implementation
items.narrative: Implements Call interface for WhatsApp. Backed by a WhatsAppCallEvent and WhatsAppConnectionManager. accept() delegates to manager.answerCall(). reject() delegates to manager.rejectCall(). Audio/video streams bridged from WASocket audio events as AsyncIterable<Buffer>. State driven by WASocket call state events (ringing, connected, ended). getAgentBridge returns a BaseAgentBridge instance wired to this call's media.

items.title: src/providers/whatsapp/whatsapp-voice-provider.ts — WhatsAppVoiceProvider
items.narrative: FR-6. Implements VoiceProvider. name = 'whatsapp'. supportedMedia = ['audio', 'video', 'screen'] as const. Constructor takes manager: WhatsAppConnectionManager and calls manager.registerVoiceProvider(this). createCall creates an outbound WhatsAppCall. joinGroupCall delegates to manager.joinGroupCall. Incoming call events from manager.onCallEvent() are converted to WhatsAppCall instances and surfaced via onCall handlers.

items.title: test/providers/whatsapp/whatsapp-voice-provider.test.ts — unit tests with mock manager
items.narrative: Create a MockWhatsAppConnectionManager that captures registerVoiceProvider calls and allows programmatic call event injection. Test: incoming call event → WhatsAppCall created → accept/reject → correct manager methods called. Test: single-socket invariant (registerVoiceProvider called once). Test: outbound createCall calls manager correctly.

items.title: test/providers/whatsapp/whatsapp-call.test.ts — state machine tests
items.narrative: Using MockWhatsAppConnectionManager: test full lifecycle (ringing → connecting → connected → ended). Test accept with video:false and video:true options. Test error propagation from manager errors into CallError.media-failure.
